WITH order_item_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0
      THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_item_count
FROM order_item_stats
